name: Minimum Length
description: Requires text to be at least {value} characters.

name: Maximum Length
description: Requires text to be no longer than {value} characters.

name: Exact Length
description: Requires text to be exactly {value} characters.

name: Regex Pattern
description: Requires text to match the regular expression: {value}.

name: Contains Text
description: Requires text to contain the substring: {value}.

name: Starts With
description: Requires text to start with: {value}.

name: Ends With
description: Requires text to end with: {value}.

name: Email Address
description: Requires a valid email address format.

name: URL
description: Requires a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL.

name: UUID
description: Requires a valid UUID format.

name: Language Code
description: Requires a well-formed BCP-47 language tag.

name: Lowercase
description: Requires all characters to be lowercase.

name: Uppercase
description: Requires all characters to be uppercase.

name: Trimmed
description: Requires no leading or trailing whitespace.

name: Not Empty
description: Requires text to contain at least one non-whitespace character.

name: Human-Readable Text
description: Marks a field as human-readable text.

name: Date Format
description: Requires date/time string to match format pattern: {value}.

name: ISO Date
description: Requires a valid ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: ISO Date-Time
description: Requires a valid ISO-8601 date-time timestamp.

name: ISO Time
description: Requires a valid ISO-8601 time (HH:mm:ss).

name: Not Null
description: Requires the value to be present and not null.

name: Allowed Values
description: Restricts the value to a predefined list of allowed strings: {value}.

name: After Date
description: Requires date/time to be chronologically after {value}.

name: Before Date
description: Requires date/time to be chronologically before {value}.

name: Greater Than
description: Requires the number to be strictly greater than {value}.

name: Greater Than or Equal
description: Requires the number to be greater than or equal to {value}.

name: Less Than
description: Requires the number to be strictly less than {value}.

name: Less Than or Equal
description: Requires the number to be less than or equal to {value}.

name: Positive Number
description: Requires a number strictly greater than zero.

name: Negative Number
description: Requires a number strictly less than zero.

name: Positive Integer
description: Requires a whole number strictly greater than zero.

name: Negative Integer
description: Requires a whole number strictly less than zero.

name: Multiple Of
description: Requires the number to be a multiple of {value}.

name: Decimal Precision
description: Restricts the maximum number of decimal places to {value}.

name: Epoch Seconds
description: Requires a whole-number Unix timestamp in seconds.

name: Epoch Milliseconds
description: Requires a whole-number Unix timestamp in milliseconds.

name: List Size Range
description: Restricts the number of items in a list to the range {value}.

name: Unique Items
description: Requires all items in the list to be distinct.

name: Is True
description: Requires a boolean value to be true.

name: Is False
description: Requires a boolean value to be false.
